content.title: Lox Pratt
content.text: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Lox PrattBornCornwall, EnglandOccupationActorYears active2024–present Lox Pratt is a British actor. He is best known for portraying Jack in the BBC television adaptation of Lord of the Flies and for being cast as Draco Malfoy in HBO's upcoming Harry Potter television series.[1][2] In 2024, Pratt was cast as Jack in the four-part BBC One and BBC iPlayer adaptation of Lord of the Flies, written by Jack Thorne and directed by Marc Munden.[3] Filming took place in Malaysia.[4] The series premiered in February 2026 and received positive critical reviews, with praise directed at its performances and contemporary reworking of William Golding’s novel.[5] In June 2025, HBO announced that Pratt would portray Draco Malfoy in its forthcoming television adaptation of the Harry Potter franchise, with Johnny Flynn cast as Lucius Malfoy.[6] Filming was scheduled to begin in summer 2025, ahead of an expected release in 2026.[7] Pratt was born and raised in Cornwall, England. In interviews, he has spoken about developing an early interest in storytelling, filmmaking, dancing, and writing, which led him to pursue acting from a young age.[8] He joined a local drama group and later attended an open casting call, which resulted in his first major television role in Lord of the Flies.[9] Pratt has also expressed an interest in exploring directing and writing in the future.[10] Year Title Role Notes 2026 Lord of the Flies Jack Main cast; BBC One and BBC iPlayer 2026–present Harry Potter Draco Malfoy Television series ^ Bentz, Adam (September 5, 2024).
